raw_response:
I will stay close to what worked for me last season, but I will put some money into this maize because this is my own land and I do not want a weak harvest. I can read the seed and fertilizer bags, and here in Manyara I have seen neighbors get better maize when they use improved seed and a little fertilizer, even if they cannot afford heavy application. I will still keep costs in check, use manure where I can, and depend mostly on family work with some hired help at planting and weeding.
